body:
Some more data points: Same issue here on 4.4.1.

I adapted the example to have two consecutive loads of the same resource (along with two labels to test the values). Because I first suspected some ResourceLoader ("caching") issue.

I also printed the value as well as the type of the value like so:
```gdscript
var character:Character = load("res://resources/character_main.tres")

print(character.stats.health)
print(typeof(character.stats.health))

$HealthLabel.text = str(character.stats.health)
```

I also noticed different behaviour between debug and release exports.
Release shows "null" as previously estabilshed and gives the following verbose output:
```
Loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-3070c538c03ee49b7677ff960a3f5195-main.scn
Loading resource: res://main.gdc
Loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-72e6a8de04e2e3900648f9ab229a782f-character_main.res
Loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-a2beb91a797baff2688085a0a9b03efa-statblock_default.res
<null>
0
```

While debug shows nothing (blank) and never gets to the printing part (it seems like _ready() aborts execution but the program keeps running fine, _process() still gets called, screen stilll gets drawn etc). Output:
```
Loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-3070c538c03ee49b7677ff960a3f5195-main.scn
Loading resource: res://main.gdc
Loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-72e6a8de04e2e3900648f9ab229a782f-character_main.res
Loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-a2beb91a797baff2688085a0a9b03efa-statblock_default.res
SCRIPT ERROR: Invalid access to property or key 'health' on a base object of type 'Nil'.
          at: _ready (res://main.gd:6)
```
Of note: Line 6 in main.gd contains the first print statement from above

For reference this is the verbose editor output:
```
Loading resource: res://main.tscn
Loading resource: res://main.gd
Loading resource: res://resources/character_main.tres
Loading resource: res://resources/statblock_default.tres
10
2
```

Edit: I am not 100% confident but it feels like the ResourceLoader fails with remapping the resource path when nesting resources. Since remapping is not used for the editor (or rather, only exports use/need it), this would explain the symptoms. 

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d7cc121e6469d0d998bf214e3a87e37961e6f1bb/core/io/resource_loader.cpp#L289-L304

The loading works finde as far as I can tell, but there might be issues "linking back" to the base-resource that triggered the nested load when using remapped paths?
